verses.pali: Yo ca na kukkuccāyitabbaṁ kukkuccāyati, yo ca kukkuccāyitabbaṁ na kukkuccāyati.
verses.english: One who is remorseful over something they shouldn’t be, and one who isn’t remorseful over something they should be.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, bhikkhave, dvinnaṁ āsavā vaḍḍhantī”ti.
verses.english: These are the two whose defilements grow.”
